label: Low beta (beta-neutral)
blurb: Names ranked by a shrunk beta (one-year volatility ratio times the five-year correlation of three-day returns, 0.6 beta + 0.4); low-beta names long, levered to beta one, high-beta names short, de-levered to beta one.
literature: Black, Jensen & Scholes (1972); Frazzini & Pedersen (2014), Journal of Financial Economics
